title: Model-Free Passive Execution via Order-Level Shadowing
summary: Execution-method metadata retained centrally; no alpha, fill-savings or account claim.
about: A passive execution benchmark that shadows observed third-party order additions and cancellations.
findings: Author describes deterministic ES replay, latency/slippage comparisons and open-source simulator; no performance independently verified here.
mechanism: Potential placement/fill efficiency, not a new directional market signal.
build_on: Retain in execution references. Owned minute aggregates lack exchange-order identifiers and event-level queue lifecycle.
can_strategy_code_be_made: Only in an offline event-replay environment with authenticated full rules and actual order-level inputs; no live order changes.
reading_scope: Primary arXiv abstract/version metadata only, not full29-page paper.
owned_input_mapping: Needs ordered exchange MBO messages, order IDs, cancel/trade events and latency/queue assumptions, not one-minute bars.
deeper_investigation: Supporting execution watch only, not a strategy-success substitute or current acquisition task.
